thread:
emma_sales: Hey team — AcmeCorp sent a list of compliance asks for the POC. They want artifacts delivered in two batches: 1) SOC 2 excerpt + ISO cert PDF + pen-test attestation letter (signed), and 2) network diagram + staging IP window. Timeline: first batch by Wed EOD, network diagram within 48h after that.
jamal_se: can we do SOC2 excerpt + ISO cert pdf by Wed? what about a signed pen-test letter — do we have a template legal can sign? :thinking:
natalie_security: We can pull SOC2 system-description excerpt and the control mapping. ISO cert PDF is available. For the pen-test letter we typically need 3rd-party sign-off; that can take ~5 business days. We can prepare a redacted summary and an interim attestation if legal approves.
owen_legal: Interim attestation is fine. I can sign an attestation that summarizes scope and confirms we have a pen-test, but full report sharing requires NDA and approval from the 3rd-party. We should offer a redacted report for POC.
emma_sales: Customer already signed our standard NDA last week (recorded in the opportunity).
jamal_se: For network diagram + staging IPs — ops prefers a presigned S3 or secure dataroom link, not attachments in email. We should also give a test window and scan rules.
maria_cs: I can create a presigned S3 link with restricted TTL and log downloads. How long should the window be? 7 days ok?
natalie_security: 7 days is fine. Also provide ephemeral creds if they need to run an external scanner so we don't expose long-lived keys.
jamal_se: Also confirm whether they require a throwaway single-tenant staging environment for the POC. That will change cost. Emma — did they ask for dedicated tenant pricing?
emma_sales: They asked about tenant isolation as an option and want pricing if we must spin up a dedicated tenant. If dedicated required, finance quoted ~+20% for burst GPUs during the POC. I'll flag it in the quote.
own_legal: Note on the pen-test attestation: customer prefers a signed letter from our vendor. We can provide a vendor-signed attestation or our legal-signed attestation plus a redacted vendor summary. I'll prepare an attestation template for internal signature.
natalie_security: Redacted vendor summary will include vuln counts, CVSSs, and remediation status, but redact IPs and internal emails.
emma_sales: Action items: natalie — pull SOC2 excerpt + redacted pen-test summary; owen — prep attestation template; maria — create presigned S3 with 7d expiry; jamal — confirm staging/dedicated approach and add scanner checklist. I'll update the customer with plan and pricing note.
jamal_se: I'll also draft a 1-page checklist for the customer (hostnames, allowed test window, rate limits to avoid DDoS flags).
emma_sales: Who can own delivering the first batch by Wed EOD?
natalie_security: I can own SOC2 excerpt + redacted pen-test summary by Wed morning. Need the latest pen-test package location and permission to redact.
evidence_bot: Automated: latest pen-test package v2025-02-11 is available at https://internal.redwood/secure/pen-tests/2025-02-11. Access is logged; request download permission if needed.
own_legal: I'll DM @emma_sales the attestation draft by EOD for review and sign-off.
maria_cs: Presign link created: https://s3.secure.presign/acme-poc (7d expiry). Added acme@acme.com with view-only access; audit logs enabled.
emma_sales: Perfect — I'll respond to Acme with the two-batch plan, attach the ETA, and call out the dedicated-tenant pricing option. Thanks everyone :pray:
jamal_se: small reminder — if they pick dedicated tenant, we need a PO before provisioning. Emma, please add that to the quote and ops ticket.
emma_sales: Will do. I'll post a final delivery message here once the docs are uploaded and sent to the customer.
